data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Myrna is believed to be the goddess of sacred groves. Her name comes from the Greek word 'myrna', meaning 'sweet-smelling', which is fitting as she was often associated with fragrant trees and flowers. The name Myrna carries the meaning “Amythra, goddess of sacred groves” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Myrna usually hope their child will grow to embody amythra, goddess of sacred groves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
